title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026
description: The 2026 Crown Jewel, also promoted as Crown Jewel: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by the American company WWE. It was the eighth Crown Jewel and took place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the ANB Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of Riyadh Season. This was the 16th event that WWE held in Saudi Arabia under a 10-year partnership in support of Saudi Vision 2030.
